title: Weather & Delivery Impact
description: Requires a real OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY in .env for weather_enrichment_dag to populate iot.weather_observations - panels render empty until then (see docs/OBSERVABILITY.md).

panels.title: Avg delivery time by weather condition

targets.rawSql: SELECT weather_condition, avg(time_to_destination_seconds)/3600.0 AS avg_hours, count(*) AS deliveries FROM gold.fact_weather_delivery_correlation WHERE weather_condition IS NOT NULL GROUP BY weather_condition ORDER BY avg_hours DESC

SELECT width_bucket(temperature, -10, 35, 9) AS temp_bucket, avg(time_to_destination_seconds)/3600.0 AS avg_hours, count(*) AS deliveries FROM gold.fact_weather_delivery_correlation WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT purchase_order_id, zone_id, weather_condition, temperature, humidity, time_to_destination_seconds/3600.0 AS hours FROM gold.fact_weather_delivery_correlation WHERE weather_condition IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time_to_destination_seconds DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Deliveries by weather condition over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', delivery_time) AS time, weather_condition, count(*) AS deliveries FROM gold.fact_weather_delivery_correlation WHERE weather_condition IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
